name: Dinoding
text: Dinoding, also spelled Dinodig, was a former cantref of about a hundred townships in Gwynedd in north Wales. Until the 1974 local government reorganisation the territory lay within the old county of Merionethshire. Dinoding serves as a setting within the Fourth Branch of the Mabinogi. There Lleu Llaw Gyffes weds Blodeuedd and reigns as king. The cantref was a unit of medieval Welsh administration rather than a single ancient polity. The name itself combines an old Welsh element with the standard cantref suffix. See the Mabinogi entry for the wider literary setting.
